body:
Adds the first two rows of the three-dot menu described in design-doc.md ("The editor's row"): whether a model thinks before it answers, and how hard.

- `src/config.cc` — `said_how()` for how the four levels read where a person reads them, `stepped_of()` for one step either way along them, and two `set_of(asking, …)` so setting one field leaves the rest as it stood.
- `src/app/requests.cc`, `src/app/screens.cc` — two new requests, `set_thinking` and `set_effort`, carried into `asking`, so every later body is sent with them.
- `src/ui/settings.cc` — `effort_row`: the level it stands at, with `–`/`+` either side.
- `test/config_test.cc` (new, 53 lines) plus a `pchat-config-test` entry in `test/CMakeLists.txt` — the words each level is called, staying inside the four at both ends, and setting one field not touching the others.

Nothing is sent differently yet: no provider reads `asking.thinking` / `asking.how_hard` in this PR.

Carried as the base of #4, whose composer menu first holds these rows, and through #4 of #7 and #8 — each of those says so in its own body.

title: thinking asked for, and how hard, in the settings
